subject.title: docs: add Neon AI Gateway provider guide

question: Should OpenClaw’s core provider documentation maintain a dedicated guide for Neon AI Gateway even though it is an external beta service reached only through generic custom-provider configuration?
rationale: The diff is documentation-only and the supplied route evidence supports its technical premise, but the repository’s desired threshold for provider-specific guides is a product and documentation-scope choice rather than a mechanical correction.

options.title: Accept the narrowly scoped guide
options.body: Keep the page as a custom-provider walkthrough, preserving its explicit statement that Neon has no bundled plugin, onboarding path, or native provider support.

options.title: Keep Neon guidance outside core docs
options.body: Ask for a community-maintained guide or external documentation link if maintainers want core docs to cover only bundled or strategically supported provider surfaces.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrowly scoped guide
recommendation.body: Keep the page as a custom-provider walkthrough, preserving its explicit statement that Neon has no bundled plugin, onboarding path, or native provider support.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a repository-level provider-documentation scope decision rather than a narrow implementation repair.
